approvedPortals.title: Approved portals
approvedPortals.description: Origins (scheme, host and port) whose pages may use the extension without asking the user, e.g. https://portal.example.com.

defaultIfOpen.title: When the application is already open
defaultIfOpen.description: Used when a launch request does not say: 'ask' shows the confirmation page; 'close' closes the open window and continues.

defaultParallel.title: Choices offered when the application is already open
defaultParallel.description: Used when a launch request does not say: which of 'shared' (Continue without closing), 'incognito' and 'separate' (separate browser) the confirmation page offers, besides Close active session and Cancel. Default: all three.

defaultWindow.title: Window to open applications in
defaultWindow.description: Used when a launch request does not say: 'normal' or 'incognito'.
